open_issues.impact: P4.3 must add the command gui-planner.item-reopen and add `actions` (command, scope item) to the item query output and the item route
open_issues.text: Spec says item `actions: gui-planner.item-reopen`; the command does not exist before P4.3, and a route/resource-detail action pointing at an undeclared command would fail the resolver. The item query returns no actions yet.

open_issues.impact: P4.4 frontend plan context; until then plan-scope queries are rejected by the host with INPUT_INVALID
open_issues.text: Queries of scope plan/item declare the path parameters as query params (plan_id plan-ref required, item_id item-ref, ref string with pattern), because the resolver requires every path param to be a query param. The adapter takes plan_id/item_id from context and falls back to params. The host check_context needs context.plan_id/item_id for these scopes; today QueryView sends only project_id in context and path params in params, so P4.4 must put plan_id/item_id into context.

open_issues.impact: possible drift if the planner changes its definition of done
open_issues.next: consider a per-phase progress in planner later
open_issues.text: The `phases` query counts items done per phase from `show --json` statuses (done, done_with_deviations, skipped), because no planner verb gives per-phase progress; the plans-level progress comes from the `plans` verb. Same definition as the planner.

open_issues.impact: behavior of board and plans without project
open_issues.text: Board shows the column `other` only when a card has a status outside the six planner statuses; the six columns always exist. The `plans` query, when called without a project (aicore conformance probe), lists the plans of the plugin's working folder instead of failing, because ext.conformance.invoke runs example_input without a project; other queries still require the project and answer PLANNER_CONTEXT_MISSING.

open_issues.impact: P4.4 may add a phase selector to the board page
open_issues.text: Link params of phases rows hold only plan_id (path params); the phase filter of board is a query param and cannot be passed through a link, so every phase row opens the whole board.
